topics.name: Editor Self-Update and Recovery
topics.purpose: Define self-editing as edit/validate a new copy/revision, activate it, verify health and preserve rollback/recovery rather than irreversible mutation of the only active Editor definition.

semantics.candidate_rule: Self-edit produces a new candidate Editor MetaModule/site/config revision.
semantics.health_rule: New Editor health/readiness is checked explicitly.
semantics.failure_rule: Failed self-update does not destroy the previous usable Editor.
semantics.authority_rule: Self-update requires explicit Editor/config/site administration authority.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: failed self-update leaves no recovery path
new revision selected by newest file

references.purpose: Self-update operates on ordinary Editor MetaModule revisions.
Recovery remains available if new Editor fails.
